description: Phase 7D-3 — Full generated card art import complete. All 20 cards in_game.

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。黑铁圣堂的石板祭坛上，第一个蓝色OD反应炉刻度环被点亮。环内有微弱火焰，环外是暗色圣堂石柱和铜质阀门。蓝色冷光从环心向外投射到地面。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体居中占画面55%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. On a black-iron altar stone slab inside a steam cathedral, the first blue OD reactor gauge ring is lit. Faint flame inside the ring, dark cathedral pillars and copper valves outside. Blue cool light projects from the ring center onto the floor. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject centered occupying 55% of frame.
cards.notes: Blue ring + dark altar = simple readable icon | Small ritual ring glow, OD +1 float text | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一只小型黑铁机械使魔蹲伏在石板地面，四足姿态。胸口微型反应炉发出蓝色到橙色的渐变光。背部铜质热压管末端喷出细蒸汽。地面有蓝色OD刻度环的微弱投影。后景是暗色蒸汽圣堂石柱。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体居中偏下占画面60%，正面光从胸口炉心向外发散。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A small black-iron mechanical familiar crouching on stone floor, four-legged pose. Miniature reactor core in its chest glows with blue-to-orange gradient light. Copper heat pipes on its back emit thin steam trails from tips. Faint blue OD gauge-ring projection on the ground. Background shows dark steam-cathedral stone pillars in blur. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject centered-lower occupying 60% of frame, key light radiating from chest reactor outward.
cards.notes: Thumb: chest reactor glow + crouching silhouette. Field VFX: blue-orange pulse on entry, brighter pipes at L3+, orange halo at L5. | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一位轻装甲的先锋战士，手持一把刚被点燃的黑铁点火刃。刀刃从蓝色OD火焰过渡到橙色热焰。身体前倾，向画面右方突进。盔甲上有刚点燃的橙色管线。后景是暗色圣堂通道。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体居中占画面65%，刀刃火焰为最亮焦点。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A light-armored vanguard warrior holding a black-iron ignition blade just lit. Blade transitions from blue OD flame to orange heat flame. Body leans forward, charging toward the right. Armor has freshly lit orange pipe-lines. Background shows dark cathedral corridor. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject centered occupying 65% of frame, blade flame as brightest focal point.
cards.notes: Humanoid silhouette + glowing blade | Weapon glow when buffed, blade slash trail on attack | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一条隐藏的青绿色信号伏线悬在地面之上，正在切断一股红色Boss能量波形。切口处有青绿色火花。周围是暗色圣堂地面和模糊的管道。画面传达被触发前的安静瞬间。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，信号线水平横穿画面占65%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A hidden teal-green signal tripwire suspended above the ground, cutting through a red Boss energy waveform. Teal sparks at the cut point. Dark cathedral floor and blurred pipes around. Conveys the quiet moment before trigger. Sharp focus, card art composition, signal wire horizontally crossing 65% of frame.
cards.notes: Teal wire cutting red wave = clear counter/trap icon | Back-row cut-line trigger, teal spark flash | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一个圆形黑铁反应炉基座半嵌入石板地面。顶部蓝色OD刻度环缓缓旋转并向下投射冷光。侧面有铜质压力表、阀门接口和细管道。地面有蓝色投影光斑。后景是暗色地下圣堂管线。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体水平居中占画面70%，顶部刻度环为最亮焦点。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A circular black-iron reactor foundation half-buried in stone floor. Blue OD gauge ring on top rotates slowly, casting cool light downward. Copper pressure gauge, valve ports, and thin pipes on the sides. Blue light projection on the ground. Background shows dark underground cathedral pipelines. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject centered horizontally occupying 70% of frame, top gauge ring as brightest focal point.
cards.notes: Thumb: circular base + blue ring. Field VFX: ring rotates faster on interface, faint blue pulse in back row. | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一把黑铁刀刃从左侧挥入画面，刀身从蓝色OD火焰过渡到橙色热焰。刀光向前拉出短促的橙蓝色轨迹。刀刃后方是模糊的圣堂石壁和热压管线。画面有强烈的斜向动感。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，刀刃斜穿画面占70%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A black-iron blade swings into frame from the left, blade body transitioning from blue OD flame to orange heat flame. Blade light trails a short orange-blue arc behind. Blurred cathedral stone wall and heat pipes behind the blade. Strong diagonal motion feel. Sharp focus, card art composition, blade diagonally crossing 70% of frame.
cards.notes: Diagonal glowing blade = spell/attack icon | Target monster flash, blade arc VFX on hit | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一个双臂接管线的中型机械导能者站立在战场上。身体为黑铁结构，双臂和背部有铜质热压管道。胸口反应炉发出橙色光。身后有热流管线连接到地面。姿态沉稳，面向画面右侧。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体居中占画面65%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A medium-sized mechanical channeler with pipe-arms standing on the battlefield. Black-iron body structure, copper heat-pressure pipes on arms and back. Chest reactor emits orange glow. Heat flow pipes connect to the ground behind. Steady stance, facing right. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject centered occupying 65% of frame.
cards.notes: Humanoid mech silhouette + chest orange glow | Body pipes brighten at L3+, orange battle aura at L5 | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一座从圣堂地底伸出的垂直压力继电塔。塔身有活塞、压力阀门和橙色热压管线。塔顶有蓝色OD relay节点发出脉冲光环。底部有深渊裂纹被塔基压制。塔身两侧有蒸汽释放。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，塔垂直居中占画面75%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A vertical pressure relay tower rising from the cathedral underground. Tower body features pistons, pressure valves, and orange heat-pressure pipes. Blue OD relay node at the top emits a pulse halo. Abyss cracks suppressed by the tower base. Steam vents from both sides. Sharp focus, card art composition, tower vertically centered occupying 75% of frame.
cards.notes: Vertical tower + blue pulse ring on top | Tower-top pressure flash on interface, relay nodes pulse | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一个OD核心向外释放环形脉冲波。脉冲波边缘为红紫色，中心为蓝色。脉冲波扫过画面中的敌方怪兽轮廓，使其震动模糊。背景是暗色圣堂内部和模糊的齿轮管线。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，脉冲环居中占画面70%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. An OD core releasing a ring-shaped pulse wave outward. Pulse wave edge is red-violet, center is blue. The pulse sweeps across enemy monster silhouettes in frame, causing vibration blur. Background shows dark cathedral interior with blurred gear pipelines. Sharp focus, card art composition, pulse ring centered occupying 70% of frame.
cards.notes: Concentric ring pulse on dark background | Action-slot shock pulse, ring expands and fades | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一个背负链式导管的中型机械怪兽站立在战场上。身体连接多个能量节点，蓝色和橙色能量流过导管。背后有铜质链条连接到地面或其他单位。胸口的反应炉发出稳定的橙色光。姿态稳固，像战场中继站。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体居中占画面65%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A medium mechanical monster with chain conduits on its back, standing on the battlefield. Body connects to multiple energy nodes, blue and orange energy flowing through conduits. Copper chains on the back link to the ground or other units. Chest reactor emits steady orange glow. Stable stance, like a battlefield relay station. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject centered occupying 65% of frame.
cards.notes: Chain conduits + energy flow = bridge unit icon | Chain glow between allies, conduit energy accelerates at L5 | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。青绿色冷却液从上方管道涌入一组过热发红的黑铁管线。冷却液接触管线的位置有蒸汽爆发。紫色Depth裂纹在管线表面被冷却液压制褪色。画面传达紧急降温的瞬间。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，冷却液流垂直贯穿画面占70%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. Teal-green coolant flooding into a set of overheated red-glowing black-iron pipes from above. Steam bursts where coolant contacts the pipes. Purple Depth cracks on the pipe surface are suppressed and fade under the coolant. Conveys emergency cooling moment. Sharp focus, card art composition, coolant flow vertically crossing 70% of frame.
cards.notes: Teal flow over red pipes = clear control/recovery icon | Depth - text near gauge, coolant splash on resolve | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。青绿色干扰波形像锁链一样缠绕住一条红色Boss OD信号波形。多个信号节点沿干扰波亮起。红色波形被压缩变弱。暗色圣堂背景，焦点在信号交叉点。画面传达信号战的精确感。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，干扰波水平横穿画面占70%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. Teal-green interference waveforms wrapping like chains around a red Boss OD signal wave. Multiple signal nodes light up along the interference. Red waveform is compressed and weakened. Dark cathedral background, focus on the signal intersection. Conveys signal warfare precision. Sharp focus, card art composition, interference wave horizontally crossing 70% of frame.
cards.notes: Teal chains over red wave = jam/interference icon | Signal glitch trigger, teal flash, Boss OD bar dips | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一个垂直的大型黑铁散热装置，多层散热鳍片像翅膀向两侧展开。中央管道有青绿色冷却液流动发光。鳍片间隙中橙色热雾被吸入。底部石板地面有紫色深渊裂纹延伸到散热片下方并被青色冷却光阻断压制。顶部释放细蒸汽。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体垂直居中占画面75%，中央冷却液管道为最亮焦点。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A large vertical black-iron heat sink device, multiple layers of cooling fins spread outward like wings. Teal-green coolant flows and glows through central pipes. Orange heat mist being drawn into the gaps between fins. Purple abyss cracks on the stone floor below are blocked and suppressed by the teal cooling light. Thin steam vents from the top. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject vertically centered occupying 75% of frame, central coolant pipe as brightest focal point.
cards.notes: Thumb: wing-shaped fins + teal center bar. Field VFX: fins unfold on entry, coolant accelerates on interface, purple cracks fade. | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一枚重型断路器装置正在切断一条发红发光的锁链。切断瞬间青绿色火花向四周飞散。锁链断裂处有热金色奖励光闪现。暗色圣堂背景，断路器为画面主体。画面传达连破坏本身也可以被破坏的逆转感。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，断路器居中占画面70%，切断点为最亮焦点。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A heavy circuit breaker device cutting through a glowing red chain. Teal-green sparks fly outward at the cut moment. Hot gold reward light flashes at the break point. Dark cathedral background, breaker is the main subject. Conveys even destruction can be destroyed reversal feel. Sharp focus, card art composition, breaker centered occupying 70% of frame, cut point as brightest focus.
cards.notes: Breaker cutting chain + sparks = control finisher icon | Chain snap VFX, teal rupture flash, Boss OD bar drops | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一个重型装甲机械巨兽站立在战场上。身体覆盖厚黑铁装甲板，背部有大型压力罐和护盾发生器。护盾板上有蓝色封压锁环。四足稳固，面向画面右侧，姿态防御性。胸口的压力表在绿色安全区。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体居中占画面70%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A heavily armored mechanical beast standing on the battlefield. Body covered in thick black-iron armor plates, large pressure tanks and shield generators on its back. Blue containment lock rings on the shield plates. Four-legged stable stance, facing right, defensive pose. Chest pressure gauge in green safe zone. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject centered occupying 70% of frame.
cards.notes: Heavy armored silhouette + blue shield rings | Thick shield border on field, shield plates brighten at L5 | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一面巨大的黑铁封压墙竖立在深渊裂口前方。墙面有蓝色封压锁环和铜质铆钉。墙后可见紫色深渊裂纹试图突破但被封锁。墙面中央有青绿色封印线纵横交错。画面传达最后的防线感。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，墙体水平占满画面85%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A massive black-iron containment wall standing before an abyss fissure. Blue containment lock rings and copper rivets on the wall surface. Purple abyss cracks visible behind the wall, attempting to break through but sealed. Teal-green sealing lines crisscross the wall center. Conveys last line of defense feeling. Sharp focus, card art composition, wall horizontally filling 85% of frame.
cards.notes: Horizontal wall + blue lock rings = defense icon | Hard teal lock glow, wall crack-repair animation when passive triggers | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一个过热的黑铁炉心侧面的紧急泄压阀被打开。橙红色蒸汽从阀门猛烈喷出，被导入上方的青绿色冷却管道。蒸汽喷射方向为斜向上。阀门周围有压力表指针跳入红色区域。画面传达紧急刹车的瞬间。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，泄压阀居中占画面65%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. An emergency vent valve on the side of an overheated black-iron reactor core being opened. Orange-red steam blasts violently from the valve, being redirected into teal-green coolant pipes above. Steam jets diagonally upward. Pressure gauge near the valve has its needle jumping into the red zone. Conveys emergency brake moment. Sharp focus, card art composition, vent valve centered occupying 65% of frame.
cards.notes: Steam blast + green coolant pipe = vent/recovery icon | Vent burst, steam cloud, OD/Depth relief float text | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一道巨大的白金色斜向斩击刀光划过整个战场画面。刀光边缘为热金色，背景是满刻度的OD Core仪表盘和红紫色边缘。画面下方的战场地面被刀光余波照亮。画面传达这一剑是整场战斗的句号。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，刀光从左下到右上斜穿画面占85%。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A massive platinum-white diagonal slash blade-light cutting across the entire battlefield frame. Blade-light edge is hot gold, background shows a full-scale OD Core gauge panel with red-violet edges. Battlefield ground below is lit by the blade afterglow. Conveys this slash ends the battle. Sharp focus, card art composition, blade-light diagonally crossing from bottom-left to top-right occupying 85% of frame.
cards.notes: Diagonal white-gold slash = finisher icon | Brief screen darken + slash flash, heavy screen shake | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。宏伟的黑铁蒸汽圣堂内部。中央悬浮一个反应炉祭坛发出白金色核心光。围绕祭坛有5层引擎光环（蓝→青→蓝→紫→红金），每层有齿轮和OD刻度标记。底部是深渊裂隙被圣堂结构压制在下方。两侧有巨大的黑铁柱和铜质管风琴式管道阵列。石板地面有OD刻度环投影。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，主体居中占画面85%，祭坛在正中心，光环完整可见。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. Grand interior of a black-iron steam cathedral. A suspended reactor altar at center emits platinum-white core light. Five concentric engine halos surround the altar (blue-cyan-blue-violet-red-gold), each ring marked with gears and OD gauge ticks. Abyss fissure below is suppressed by the cathedral structure. Massive black-iron pillars and copper pipe-organ arrays on both sides. Stone floor shows OD gauge-ring projections. Sharp focus, card art composition, subject centered occupying 85% of frame, altar at exact center, all five halos fully visible.
cards.notes: Thumb: 5 concentric rings + center light. Field VFX: halos light up 1-5 on entry, all pulse on interface, strongest building glow. | Phase 7D-3 full generated import

cards.prompt_cn: 幻想工业风格卡牌插画。一道垂直的毁灭性引擎能量柱从地面裂缝中喷发而出。核心白金色向外渐变为热金色和红紫色。石板地面被撕裂翻开，下方是深渊裂隙。能量柱周围有电弧和碎片飞散。画面边缘有被冲击波推开的引擎光环碎片。上方圣堂穹顶被能量光照亮。焦点清晰，卡牌插画构图，能量柱垂直贯穿画面占90%，光从核心向外辐射。
cards.prompt_en: Fantasy industrial card illustration. A vertical destructive engine energy column erupting from a ground fissure. Core is platinum-white, transitioning outward to hot gold and red-violet. Stone floor slabs are torn and flipped, revealing abyss fissures below. Electrical arcs and debris fly around the energy column. Fragments of engine halos are pushed to the frame edges by the shockwave. Cathedral ceiling above is illuminated by the energy light. Sharp focus, card art composition, energy column vertically piercing 90% of the frame, light radiating from core outward.
cards.notes: Thumb: vertical gold-red energy column on dark background. Field VFX: full-screen white flash, energy column at BossCore, heavy shake. | Phase 7D-3 full generated import
